The critical path of a typical scope is shorter than before on the same input.') plus a real failure: tools/ticket-manifest.mjs turns a ledger ticket into a run manifest; when a ticket's output file is referenced by more than 100 project tests, the generated manifest fails validation with 'Uncovered test references' (T-0040's own ticket hit this). Fix both in tools/ticket-manifest.mjs only: (1) a build ticket's generated job lists its own test file(s) (ticket.tests) as OUTPUTS (it writes or owns them) and its prompt says it must create/update those tests with the code; (2) uncovered test references: rank the referencing tests by relevance (same basename stem as an output, then tests named in ticket.tests/context, then tests that import the output directly, then the rest), put at most 12 of the most relevant into context, and put every other referencing test into ignoreTests with a generated one-line reason in the prompt ('N other tests import <file> for unrelated behavior; the coordinator runs the full suite'). Use the same helper the validator uses to find referencing tests if one is exported (read tools/ticket-manifest.mjs and its imports), else a small local scan.
